newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ConsPress sells 15 pct of Crown.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ConsPress sells 15 pct of Crown.

text.p: Crown Casino Ltd said on Tuesday that businessman Kerry Packer's Consolidated press Holdings Ltd had sold 75 million Crown shares, or about 15 percent of the issued capital, at a price of A$2.72 per share.
Crown said the deal had been arranged through investment house BZW, with ConsPress saying it would not sell its remaining 47.4 million shares for at least six months.

The company said Conspress had informed it that it wished to liquefy some assets for use in other transactions and the sale did not reflect on its confidence in Crown, in which it continued to hold both direct interests and indirect interests through Hudson Conway Ltd.
Crown shares closed one cent lower at A$3.01 on turnover of 606,443 shares.
